regime.reason: Correção de morfologia pública de ContextBlock com obrigação, contrato, oráculos, ataques, implementação e veredito segregados.

manifest.status: candidate; hash is recorded by downstream receipts after creation

scope: Representação opaca e invariável de todo Content::ContextBlock como context(), sem observar corpo, closure, identidade ou origem.

classification.intent_evidence: A fonte ratificada representa elementos por handles ou fields públicos, enquanto ContextElem possui somente o field interno func; a forma pública resultante não recebe argumentos.
classification.refuted_by: Field público na fonte ratificada, sonda bilateral válida de qualquer ContextBlock com forma diferente de context(), ou necessidade demonstrada de alterar entidade, construção, parser, eval, layout, closure ou helper geral.

obligations.subject: every Content::ContextBlock
obligations.must: Emit exactly context() regardless of body, closure, identity, span, syntactic origin, or evaluated content.
must_not: emit context(...) or any other punctuation
inspect or represent body or closure
branch on equality, hash, address, id, span, or origin

obligations.subject: repr branches and general helpers outside Content::ContextBlock
obligations.must: Preserve the generic function form (..) => .. and ordinary content form [x], and leave every unrelated representation under its owner.
must_not: alter general closure or function repr
alter general content or constructor helpers

requirements: textual bodies with different payloads converge
no ellipsis or payload is exposed

authorized_delta.test_only: Add or update only directly contradictory local expectations without compiling the monolithic lib-test.
forbidden: public API, fields, traits, or signatures

oracle_policy.preserved: Caso válido coincide exatamente com a morfologia ratificada congelada.
oracle_policy.violated: Mutação negativa válida diverge e produz testemunha pública atribuível.
oracle_policy.unknown: Identidade ambígua, parse ou construção sem suporte, build ou execução falho, exit inesperado, timeout, OOM, swap, limite de RSS, saída ausente, stream acima de 64 KiB, truncado ou ilegível, budget esgotado ou evidência não bilateral.

mutation_gate.formula: valid negative mutations rejected / valid negative mutations

forbidden: parallel probes, builds, checks, or lint

calibration_budget.execution_order: Run affected slices and boundary controls first; run full corpus, repetition, and reverse order only after the focal slice passes.
stop_and_redesign_if: two consecutive revisions have the same vector and cause
opaque and positive cases regress without monotonic boundary progress
mutation score is already 1.0 but controls remain unresolved
required classification depends on unavailable public information
marginal cost exceeds budget without a new witness or hypothesis

read_allowlist: tekt-materializacao-segregada skill and its two direct references
provided bilateral measurements and frozen binary identities
P1397 and P1398 contract structures as historical formatting references
role_capabilities.context_inherited: Role assignment, repository instructions, frozen state and measurements, required source pins, memory limits, and explicit absence of a candidate patch.

role_capabilities.restriction: Writes only oracle suite and receipts before candidate; never adapts expected output to a patch.

role_capabilities.inputs: candidate manifest, L0, contract, and baseline
role_capabilities.restriction: Writes only mutants, attacks, and receipts; never chooses or repairs the solution.

role_capabilities.inputs: sealed prompt, contract, oracles, mutants, and authorized delta
role_capabilities.restriction: Changes only the authorized productive branch and directly related expectations; never edits protected contract inputs.
Writes receipts and verdict without editing any judged material.

scope_out: functional parity beyond the frozen morphology fragment

limitations.isolation: Shared workspace; hashes identify inputs and order but do not attest capability isolation.
limitations.claim_boundary: The future verdict may cover only the frozen ContextBlock repr fragment, never general functional equivalence.
